Apple Watch Series 12 Where to Buy: $399 $329 at Amazon $399 $329 at Walmart $399 $329 at Best Buy The Series 12 stands out compared to previous models with its new AI-powered Audio Intelligence features, which are made possible by Apple’s new S11 chip. The new chip also makes Siri more responsive, so you can get answers to questions with less waiting around. It’s not all about AI, though. The Series 12 also features redesigned health sensors that can now track your heart rate every five seconds even when you’re not exercising, which is particularly help if you have a chronic condition and need to keep a closer eye on your heart rate. It also introduces a new readiness score to help you decide how prepared your body is for the day. Other highlights include easier navigation with simple pinch gestures, and faster charging, which helps to make up for the fact that battery life is rated at up to 24 hours on a single charge, just like the previous-generation model.
